decisions.reason: As a bread closely aligned with the established range and publicly introduced on its own page, it likely benefits from recent commitment and there is no clear evidence yet that would force management to admit failure.
Because it was presented as a flagship product and even received a gold medal, management has both strong public commitment and positive justification to continue it.
This product extends the firm’s core bread business with limited risk, and recent launch visibility makes management inclined to persist rather than reverse course quickly.
Although somewhat more specialized in taste, it still builds directly on the bakery’s traditional competencies, so recent investment and the absence of clear failure support keeping it for now.
A marzipan Christmas stollen fits the firm’s seasonal confectionery strengths well, and management is likely to maintain it because it is close to the core offer and not evidently unsuccessful.
The firm marketed this ancient grain bread as its newest masterpiece, which creates visible commitment and makes management more likely to continue despite any early uncertainty.
